scale.note: Photographs alone do not determine real-world size. Units are arbitrary (median camera-to-object distance = 1). Calibrate with a known distance to get real measurements.

viewpoint_coverage.note: Where registered photos were taken from, around the object. This is viewpoint coverage — it does not prove the facing surface was reconstructed.

message: Depth maps are computed at 800 px instead of 1200 px so that 72 photos fit in the companion's memory limit (5120 MB). Raise the limit for full detail.

surface_coverage.note: Share of the object-region surface area with photographic support, by the direction the surface faces. Derived from the reconstructed mesh and its evidence.
